title: config: GroupsConfig wildmat pattern validation + all-negation rejection
description:
## What
Update GroupsConfig validation in transit/src/config.rs to accept wildmat patterns (bare names, comp.*, !alt.*) instead of rejecting them; add all-negation rejection at startup.

## Algorithm
1. In config.rs, add validate_group_pattern(s: &str) -> Result<(), ConfigError>:
   a. Strip leading '!' if present (negation prefix is allowed)
   b. Remainder must be non-empty (return Err if empty)
   c. Each character must be in: [a-z0-9+\-_.?*] (extend RFC 3977 charset with wildcards)
   d. No consecutive dots ('..') allowed
   e. Return Ok(())
2. In Config::validate(), replace the loop that calls validate_group_name(name) for groups.names entries with validate_group_pattern(name)
3. After the loop, call GroupFilter::new(&self.groups.names): if Err(WildmatError::AllNegation) return ConfigError::Validation("groups.names must contain at least one positive (non-negated) pattern")
4. Do NOT store the GroupFilter on Config (it is constructed at pipeline startup in whss.5 / whss.6)
5. Keep validate_group_name() unchanged for all other uses (article ingestion validation)

## Defensive programming rules
- validate_group_pattern must not allow NUL bytes or non-ASCII
- ConfigError::Validation messages must be human-readable and actionable
- Empty groups.names list: validate_group_pattern is not called, GroupFilter::new([]) returns Err(AllNegation), config fails — this is correct behavior
- Do not change GroupsConfig::names type (still Vec<String>)

## Agent team
Standard: Agent R (read config.rs validate() and validate_group_name()), Agent I (implement validate_group_pattern + update validate()), Agent V (cargo test -p stoa-transit + clippy)

## Tests (oracle: TOML parsing + expected error messages)
- valid_wildmat_pattern: validate_group_pattern("comp.*") = Ok(())
- valid_negation_pattern: validate_group_pattern("!alt.binaries.*") = Ok(())
- valid_exact_name: validate_group_pattern("alt.test") = Ok(())
- invalid_uppercase: validate_group_pattern("Comp.*") = Err (uppercase not in RFC 3977 group names)
- invalid_empty: validate_group_pattern("") = Err
- invalid_double_dot: validate_group_pattern("comp..rust") = Err
- all_negation_config_fails: Config with names=["!comp.*"] fails validate() with AllNegation message
- mixed_config_ok: Config with names=["comp.*", "!alt.binaries.*"] passes validate()
